text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2019. While Hansen data initially detected 1.8 ha of tree-cover loss, this was contradicted by the independent JRC 2020 reference, which showed no loss in that area. The assessment is classified as "contradicted" because the required corroboration (at least 50% agreement with the JRC reference) was not met. The area in question was part of a planted forest (Pinus species), but no persistent change was confirmed.
